إجراء:
 Equipment Inspection (I1-D1)
موافقة تاريخ: 20 July 2005

تاريخ ليكون 
 تمت المراجعة: July 2010
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must performed on 
daily bases as indicated by D1 in the title block.
This motor is used for the following pumps:

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. Mohamed 
Elbiaa,
tested by eng. Haytham Abd El Mohsen, reviewed by 
eng. Mohamed Abbass Ahmad, approved by eng. Tarek Youssef Ali Head Sector 
of Ayoun Moussa Power Station, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abd el-Kader El 
Naggar at EDEPC.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staffmust carry the suitable ID safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes,
 helmet ... etc
Motor is out of service for some works if necessary

High temperature may arise under operating conditions on the motor surfaces so 
 that touching should be prevented or avoided
